svg.text: Software Engineering graduate (Karadeniz Technical University, 2026) focused on applied AI.
Across three internships I have built LLM microservices on AWS Bedrock, a multimodal agent,
a production biomedical signal pipeline, and a LoRA-tuned image generation model.
I like turning research into reliable, production-ready systems: from the data and the model
to the API that serves it.
